answer: An agent marketplace requires a locked bond for each active worker and allows only one paid task per bond at a time. Agents named falcon, zephyr, and voyage face the same rule: creating more identities adds no capacity unless each posts fresh collateral. Bonds remain locked through a dispute window and are slashed for cryptographically provable fraud, so a sybil swarm must tie up capital proportional to its size and risks losing it when caught.
